scope: Focused text-only editorial review of immutable source segments 481–560 (80 segments). All 302 source word occurrences are accounted for in exact order and spelling: 280 eligible and 22 explicitly excluded sound/action-description occurrences. Includes 261 contextual explanations and 280 four-option choice overrides, covering every eligible occurrence; 9 segments are wholly non-educational sound/action-only segments. Speaker-role labels and numeric speaker identifiers accompanying intelligible speech remain eligible, as do meaningful interjections, hesitation markers, colloquialisms, and names. There are no spelling/name holds. İbretiâlem is preserved with a primary TDK spelling witness; the fixed expression sorması ayıptır is explained using primary Turkish linguistic research on its related politeness formula. Plural Gardiyanlar with singular-form sokmadı is retained as valid usage, not silently corrected. Context distinguishes uyuyoruz as compliance, saz and çalarım as musical vocabulary, explanatory da, ritual military replies, and figurative threats. References document linguistic points only, not audiovisual verification. No audiovisual verification, native-speaker certification, device acceptance, or full-film editorial acceptance is claimed.
